description: This Kotlin source file defines a repository class CategoryRepository that provides methods to fetch homepage category items from an API or fallback data. It manages offline mode detection, makes API calls, and offers error handling with result wrapping.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class that fetches and provides content items for categories, with offline fallback and error handling.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Fetches content items for a given category, either from API or using offline sample data.

methods.name: sampleItemsFor
methods.description: Generates a list of sample ContentItem objects for a specified category.

methods.name: safeFetch
methods.description: Executes a block of code and wraps it in a Result to handle exceptions gracefully.
